description: Evaluates whether the skill produces distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces

criteria.description: Must NOT use generic 3-column equal-width card grids or cookie-cutter layouts
Must include responsive breakpoints for mobile, tablet, desktop
Must include ARIA labels, focus states, keyboard navigation, WCAG contrast
Animations must use transform/opacity only (GPU composited), spring easing, not linear
Must design dark-first with proper contrast ratios on dark backgrounds
Interactive elements must have 44px+ minimum touch targets
Must include loading, empty, and error states for data-driven components
Must use intentional font sizing with clear visual hierarchy (not all same size)

testPrompt: Build a client profile card component for a fitness training app. It shows the client's name, photo, fitness goal, workout count, session count, and an onboarding progress bar. Must work on mobile and desktop with dark theme.
